purpose: Thematic material design references; final registered native 32px outputs are SourceArt/NativeV6 and Art. These references are not runtime sprites or evidence of exact palette, integer outline or seam correctness.

edits.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: ANIMOL 2D side-view platformer thematic pixel-art terrain design sheet. Input image is EDIT TARGET, preserve its four rows and four columns (material, full frame, internal-hole frame, cross motif), retain exact theme identity, colors, architectural trim and motifs. Refine ONLY the requested material pattern and border consistency. This is a pixel-art source design reference; no text, labels, watermark, game characters or new alternative design. Replace broad blank material interiors with deliberate LARGE organized modular material clusters, long straight seams, flat limited colors, simple one-pixel-style lower shadow facets and top highlights; rounded blunt corners. Every instance of each material/frame/hole in a row must have identical material pattern. Crisp clean steps, no dots, speckles, random grain, stipple, irregular doubled outlines or anti-aliased appearance. Top surface must be a thin flat horizontal side-view edge, absolutely no isometric/top-view/tilted platform surface. Frame/hole elbows connect cleanly to adjacent directional trims without protruding fins. Preserve themed underside finishing. Use only Sweetie16 palette: #1a1c2c,#5d275d,#b13e53,#ef7d57,#ffcd75,#a7f070,#38b764,#257179,#29366f,#3b5dc9,#41a6f6,#73eff7,#f4f4f4,#94b0c2,#566c86,#333c57. Each row needs unique structural material detail rather than recoloring identical bricks. Preserve clean silhouette and sparse meaningful flat facets. Transparent background outside sprites; internal hole fully transparent.
Theme-specific edit: Moon palace. Leave first jade row's design identity unchanged as historical reference (its final native v5 brick body is already fixed separately). Rows B/C/D need material detail: B warm terracotta coin-keyed staggered masonry with occasional broad gold joint plates; C cool blue compressed jade panes with simple flat blue lower facets and a few jade inset medallion panels; D deep plum eave mortise wall with broad inset purple sections and paired roof joinery accents. Keep white/coral cap, plum posts and gold palace collars of each original row.
